reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original text with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (fee payment under the Fee Schedule; maintenance fees) contain no most-favoured-nation, best-price, or third-party-offer-matching mechanic, so no MFN obligation burdens Sparkling (the Customer).

Rationale correctly identifies Sparkling as our party and Garman as vendor, and correctly notes that the preferred position (no MFN on Customer) is met; the observation that a vendor-granted MFN would be welcome is properly framed as commentary rather than a deviation.
No actionable redline is required, and none is proposed — appropriate under the classification semantics for compliant findings.
